targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS d,
  uniq(username) as "Total_Username",
  uniq(origin) as "Total_Origin",
  uniq(apphost) as "Total_EAA_APPS",
  uniq(cloudZone) as "Total_cloudZone",
  SUM(bytesIn) "Incoming",
  SUM(bytesOut) "Outgoing",
  uniq(conUuid) as "Total_Connectors"
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
  AND origin != '-'
  AND username != '-'
  AND apphost != '-'
  and conUuid != '-'  
GROUP BY  d
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Users per APP; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Origins Observability
LAST 30 MINS Analysis for EAA Destinations

panels.description:
This indicator shows the current logged in users for the last 30 Minutes, and the trend over the 30 minutes before. 

Up Arrow: Positive Trend
Down Arrow: Negative Trend

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    uniq(username) AS Total_Username,
    d
FROM (
    SELECT
        username,
        CASE
            WHEN datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE
             AND datetime <  now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
                THEN toStartOfMinute(now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
            WHEN datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 75 MINUTE
             AND datetime <  now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE
                THEN toStartOfMinute(now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE)
        END AS d
    FROM ${table}
    WHERE datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 75 MINUTE
      AND username != '-'
      AND origin != '-'
      AND ${generalescaping}
      AND $__adHocFilter()
) t
WHERE d IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d
ORDER BY d ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Connected users; du=${__user.login}';

    d

    SELECT
        apphost,
        CASE
            WHEN datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE
             AND datetime <  now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
                THEN toStartOfMinute(now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
            WHEN datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 75 MINUTE
             AND datetime <  now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE
                THEN toStartOfMinute(now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE)
        END AS d
    FROM ${table}
    WHERE datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 75 MINUTE
      AND username != '-'
      AND origin != '-'
      AND ${generalescaping}
      AND $__adHocFilter()
) t
WHERE d IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d
ORDER BY d ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS d,
  avg(originRespTime) as "Origin_Response_Time",
  avg(connectorRespTime) as "Connector_Response_Time",
  avg(totalRespTime) as "Total_Response_Time"
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND origin != '-'
  AND username != '-'
  AND apphost != '-'
  and conUuid != '-' 
  and totalRespTime is not null
  and connectorRespTime is not null
  and originRespTime is not null
GROUP BY  d --, connectorRespTime, originRespTime, totalRespTime
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Response time; du=${__user.login}'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT datetime, 
       origin,
       apphost,
       username, 
       clientip, 
       cloudZone, 
       geoCountry, 
       geoCity, 
       originRespTime, 
       totalRespTime, 
       errorCode,
       httpMethod,
       httpVerb2,
       idpinfo,
       referer,
       sessionId,
       sessionInfo,
       statusCode,
       urlPath,
       userAgent,

       IF(clientId != '-', 'tunnel', 'application') AS application_type, 
       clientId
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
AND ${generalescaping}
AND $__adHocFilter() 

AND apphost != '-'
AND origin != '-'
AND username != '-'

ORDER BY datetime DESC
LIMIT ${querieslimit}
